d: Master Works is a Saudi technology company driving digital transformation through emerging technologies and innovative digital solutions. We empower organizations with expertise across data management, AI, software development, and digital strategy, contributing to the digital economy in line with Saudi Vision 2030.

Master Works is looking for a Project Manager, Senior to facilitate Agile delivery, lead Scrum ceremonies, and drive continuous improvement across development teams. The role focuses on sprint planning, performance monitoring, Agile coaching, and implementing Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) practices to enhance team collaboration and delivery effectiveness.
q: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
Certified Scrum Master certification is preferred.
Minimum of 5 years of experience as a Scrum Master or in a similar role.
Knowledge of Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) principles and practices.
Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to facilitate team collaboration, coach team members, and drive continuous improvement.
r: li
Initiate and own Scrum events for participating squads.
li
Lead the efforts of developing Scaled Agile management best practices.
li
Facilitate daily Scrum meetings and regular ceremonies.
li
Plan upcoming sprints for a given project, including helping the team reach a consensus on what can be achieved during the sprint.
li
Monitor and report on sprints in progress.
li
Communicate closely with Delivery Managers for alignment and planning updates.
li
Collect and analyze related metrics for trends and indicators, facilitate iteration and increment planning, and provide Agile coaching and mentoring at all levels within the organization.
li
Work with the leadership team to strategically improve the efficiency and effectiveness of Agile processes.
li
Establish SAFe Agile principles and interface with other departments to ensure clear communication regarding ongoing and upcoming development activities.

d: We are looking for a Senior Sales Executive to join our team and drive sales growth by building strong customer relationships, identifying new business opportunities, and delivering exceptional customer service.
q: 4–5 years of proven experience in commercial vehicle sales is mandatory.
Valid GCC driving license is required.
Excellent verbal and written communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
Strong customer relationship management and business development capabilities.
Good understanding of commercial vehicles and their applications across different industries.
Target-driven, proactive, and capable of working independently.
Strong interpersonal skills with a professional and customer-focused approach.
Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Business Administration, Sales, Marketing, Automotive Management, or a related field.
r: li
Drive sales of commercial vehicles, including trucks, buses, and other relevant vehicle categories.
li
Identify and develop new business opportunities across corporate, fleet, logistics, construction, and other relevant customer segments.
li
Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective customers.
li
Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable commercial vehicle solutions.
li
Prepare quotations, negotiate commercial terms, and follow up on sales opportunities to successfully close deals.
li
Achieve assigned sales targets and contribute to overall business growth.
li
Conduct customer visits, product presentations, and sales negotiations.
li
Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and customer demands to identify growth opportunities.
li
Coordinate with internal teams to ensure a smooth sales process and a high level of customer satisfaction.
